posts.title: Dependent R1CS
posts.description: Dependent R1CS In dependent R1CS , the constraint matrices are functions of all public values: both the public input and the verifier challenges. This lets public computations become matrix coefficients. We compare it with fixed-matrix split-witness R1CS, then apply it to lookups and bignum arithmetic. posts.description: Johnson beyond Johnson The Johnson bound is well known to anyone working on hash-based proof systems.
